title: Allowlist
description: Dead simple player allowlist for Velocity
body:
A dead simple player allowlist for Velocity.

Velocity Allowlist adds no commands to interface with it.
Instead, all attempts on joining the proxy are blocked, unless the player's UUID is in a text file named `allowlist.txt`.

## Usage

The file `allowlist.txt` is read every 10 seconds. Simply drop the UUIDs of friends and family in there, one line each.
You can write comments starting the line with `#` or `//`.
Player names cannot be used. The plugin will accept UUIDs only.

```
# valid comment
<valid UUID>
// another valid comment
  <valid UUID>
```
